verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੈ ਕਹਾ ਜਾਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਜਨਮਾਸਟਮੀ ਕੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa ko naam hai ajonee kaise kai janam lai kahaa jaan brat janamaasaTamee ko keeno hai ||

en.bdb: The Lord whose name is Ajoni (who is never born), how could He have taken birth. And on what reason has the foolish people fixed the Janam Ashtami (the birthday of Krishan Ji) as a day of fasting?

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਅਪਜਸੁ ਲੀਨੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa ko jagajeevan akaal abinaasee naam kaise kai badhik maario apajas leeno hai ||

en.bdb: The Lord whose name is Akal (beyond times), Eternal and who is the life-support of the whole world, how could a hunter had killed Him in the form of Krishan and earned infamy?

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਪਦੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੋਪੀਨਾਥ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਰਹ ਦੁਖ ਦੀਨੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: niramal niradhokh mokh padh jaa ke naam gopeenaath kaise hui bireh dhukh dheeno hai ||

en.bdb: The Lord whose name makes a person do good, whose name frees a person from all vices, who is emancipator, how could He be the Master of milkmaids in the form of Krishan and make them suffer in His separation?

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਮਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਹੀਨੋ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੫॥
verses.translit_en: paahan kee pratimaa ke a(n)dh ka(n)dh hai poojaaree a(n)tar agiaan mat giaan gur heeno hai ||485||

en.bdb: Those who are bereft of the initiation of True Guru, support ignorant mind in them. Such ignorants and blind people create the idols of the Life-giving, Imperishable, Timeless and Blemishless Lord reducing Him into gods and then become their followers and priests.  (485)
